title: Blutac Launcher
note: Workshop feed. A copy ships inside the exe; the app refreshes from this file on GitHub, so mods and scripts can be added here without a release.

mods.name: Quality of Life
mods.author: DavidHiFi
mods.summary: Quality of life changes for Black Ops II Zombies: menus, HUD, weapons and fixes, all toggleable in game.
mods.description: An in-game settings menu, more weapons in the Mystery Box, bonus Survival maps, chat commands and dozens of fixes. Install it from the Quality of Life page, which also handles the HD texture pack, custom sounds and controller icons.

mods.name: Octagonal Ascension BO2 REMAKE
mods.author: HD ERICK GAMES
mods.summary: A Black Ops II remake of Ascension.
mods.description: A Black Ops II remake of Ascension.

mods.name: Zombies Declassified BETA 2
mods.author: Logo2K
mods.summary: A PC port of the cancelled DLC5 expansion.
mods.description: Nine usermaps, the menu mod and BO2 sound and zone files. Requires Black Ops II with all DLC. Installs from its own GitHub release manifest.

mods.name: Health display
mods.author: Blutac Launcher
mods.summary: Shows your current health as a number on the left side of the screen.
mods.description: Adds a small "Health" readout on the left edge of the screen that updates ten times a second. It works with any map and turns off when you remove the script.

mods.name: Zombie counter
mods.author: Blutac Launcher
mods.summary: Shows how many zombies are left in the round.
mods.description: Adds a "Zombies left" readout under the left edge of the screen. It counts the zombies that are alive plus the ones still waiting to spawn, so it reaches zero when the round ends.
